role: SYNTHETIC code-path fixture (NOT a sequenced patient). The PRIMARY real demo is the fully-open Hugo 2016 melanoma patient Pt22 in demo_case_hugo_pt22.json.
description: Minimal synthetic fixture whose sole purpose is to exercise code paths the real PRIMARY demo cannot: (1) neoORF peptide generation from frameshift indels, and (2) the germline-AF and synonymous exclusion filters. The VCF carries real, well-known oncogenic variant coordinates/HGVS on GRCh38 (BRAF V600E, KRAS G12D, TP53 R248L) plus two real-style frameshifts (FBXW7 p.Lys465fs, BRCA1 p.Glu826fs), one synonymous KRAS variant (excluded), and one common-germline BRAF variant (gnomAD-filtered), so every exclusion path is visible. These variants are assembled by hand, NOT called from a single specimen, and NO binding result from this file is presented as real patient data. It is retained only because Hugo 2016's public MAF is SNV-only (0 indels), so a real melanoma case with open per-patient HLA-I cannot exercise the neoORF path.

provenance.variants: SYNTHETIC: real variant coordinates/HGVS on GRCh38 Ensembl transcripts, hand-assembled (not from one sequenced specimen).
provenance.expression: GTEx Analysis v8 (2017-06-05, RNASeQCv1.1.9) gene median TPM, Skin - Sun Exposed (Lower leg); public GTEx bucket. REFERENCE (normal-tissue) abundance, used only to exercise the abundance path in this fixture; NOT tumor-specific.
provenance.hla: common HLA-I genotype (MHCflurry-supported alleles), not a real patient's genotype.
provenance.note: REAL-DATA-ONLY contract for the SKILL's outputs: binding is real MHCflurry on real peptides/HLA; protein/CDS fetched from UniProt/Ensembl and validated; missing expression/VAF stay null (never fabricated). This fixture's *variants* are synthetic and clearly labelled as such; it is used for code-path testing, not as a scientific showcase.

primary_demo_pointer.note: Use the real, fully-open Hugo 2016 Pt22 melanoma case for the biologically faithful demo (real VAF/CCF/TPM x VAF).

benchmark.source: Wells et al., Cell 2020 (DOI:10.1016/j.cell.2020.09.015) TESLA neoepitopes, redistributed as an independent evaluation set (Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/6x87nx8jtc.1, CC BY 4.0)
